config-baseline.description: Shipped backend service defaults must stay aligned with MAP2's Tier-A low-latency target.

rules.reason: Shipped backend service targets 48 kHz as the canonical Tier-A operating point.
The default release path must not regress above 64 samples.
64 samples at 48 kHz is approximately 1.33 ms nominal callback cadence.

release-smoke.description: Short release gating evidence for local build and startup sanity.

rules.reason: Release smoke must run at the canonical 48 kHz operating point.
Release smoke must preserve the 64-sample target.
No xruns are acceptable in the short release smoke window.
P99 callback jitter should stay well below one third of the nominal buffer interval.
Backend readiness should remain inside a one-minute startup window.

soak-30m.description: Release-grade 30 minute stability/latency evidence for the main audio path.

rules.reason: Soak evidence is only comparable if the canonical sample rate is preserved.
Release soak must preserve the Tier-A buffer target.
Thirty-minute release soak should complete with zero xruns.
P99 callback jitter should stay comfortably inside the nominal buffer interval.
Extreme callback jitter outliers must remain bounded.
Peak CPU must leave headroom for transient workload spikes.
